name: CIB seven - Mail Send
description: Send an e-mail from a Service Task via the CIB seven mail connector (connectorId: mail-send). SMTP settings come from MAIL_CONFIG.

properties.label: From
properties.description: Sender address. Optional – falls back to the 'sender' configured in MAIL_CONFIG if left empty.

properties.label: From alias
properties.description: Display name shown for the sender, e.g. "Support Team". Falls back to 'sender.alias' from MAIL_CONFIG.

properties.label: To
properties.description: Recipient address(es). Comma-separated, or an expression resolving to the addresses, e.g. ${customerEmail}.

properties.label: Cc
properties.description: Optional. Comma-separated address(es) or an expression.

properties.label: Bcc
properties.description: Optional. Comma-separated address(es) or an expression.

properties.label: Text body format
properties.description: How the text body is rendered. 'Plain' lets the engine resolve ${...} as a JUEL expression. 'FreeMarker template' writes the body as a camunda:script and supports full FreeMarker syntax (<#if>, <#list>, ...) - it requires a FreeMarker template engine on the classpath. This field is a modeler-only switch; the connector ignores it.

properties.label: Text body
properties.description: Plain-text body. Provide a text body and/or an HTML body. ${...} is resolved by the engine as a JUEL expression.

properties.label: Text body (FreeMarker)
properties.description: Plain-text body rendered by FreeMarker before the mail is built. Full FreeMarker syntax is available; process variables are the data model.

properties.label: HTML body
properties.description: HTML body. Provide a text body and/or an HTML body.

properties.label: File names
properties.description: Optional. Attachments read from the file system OF THE ENGINE (server-local absolute paths). Must be an expression resolving to List<String>, e.g. ${attachmentPaths}.

pattern.message: must be an expression resolving to a List<String> of server-local paths, e.g. ${attachmentPaths}

properties.label: Files
properties.description: Optional. Attachments passed as content. Must be an expression resolving to a Map keyed by attachment file name, e.g. ${attachments} where the map values are the file contents (byte streams / file variables).

pattern.message: must be an expression resolving to a Map<String, content>, e.g. ${attachments}
